task_input_descriptions.planner:
Task video description:
An underwater shot captures a rocky seabed in clear, turquoise-green water. The camera moves slowly forward and pans slightly to the right, revealing a large, irregular boulder covered in patches of green algae and encrusting organisms. The rock surface is textured with small crevices and lighter-colored mineral deposits. The surrounding bottom consists of smaller, scattered rocks and a sandy substrate. The lighting is natural and diffused, creating soft shadows and highlighting the varied textures of the marine environment. No distinct marine animals are visible, and the scene remains static aside from the gentle camera movement.
